name: Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate

fee.note: USD list price before tax; practice/compute costs are separate.

exam.format: 45 scored multiple-choice questions plus up to 10 unscored items, 90 minutes, proctored through Kryterion, in English, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese or Korean. No test aids. Two-year validity; six months of relevant hands-on experience recommended.

access.retake: Retakes are allowed after a 14-day wait with no limit on attempts; each attempt costs the full USD 200, and Databricks issues no free retake vouchers.

scope: End-to-end generative AI applications on Databricks.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Databricks does not publish passing scores; it says they are set statistically and can change as the exam is updated.

This entry follows the exam version published March 18, 2026 (exam guide updated the same day, although the PDF's file name says August 2026). Databricks asks candidates to recheck the exam guide two weeks before their exam date.
The exam listing offers online or test-center delivery, while the exam guide lists online proctoring only.
Recertification is due every two years by passing the current version of the exam.
